# tidychangepoint

## Usage

To install `tidychangepoint` from CRAN:

``` r
install.packages("tidychangepoint")
```

To install the development version of `tidychangepoint`:

``` r
remotes::install_github("beanumber/tidychangepoint")
```

To load it:

``` r
library(tidychangepoint)
```

## Tidy methods for changepoint analysis

The `tidychangepoint` package allows you to use any number of algorithms
for detecting changepoint sets in univariate time series with a common,
`tidyverse`-compliant interface. Currently, algorithms from
`changepoint`, `wbs`, and several genetic algorithms made accessible via
`GA` are supported. It also provides model-fitting procedures for
commonly-used parametric models, tools for computing various penalty
functions, and graphical diagnostic displays.

Changepoint sets are computed using the
[`segment()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment.md)
function, which takes a numeric vector that is coercible into a `ts`
object, and a string indicating the algorithm you wish you use.
[`segment()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment.md)
always returns a `tidycpt` object.

``` r
x <- segment(CET, method = "pelt", model = fit_meanshift_norm, minseglen = 3)
class(x)
```

``` R
## [1] "tidycpt"
```

Various methods are available for `tidycpt` objects. For example,
[`as.ts()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/ts.html) returns the original data
as `ts` object, and
[`changepoints()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/changepoints.md)
returns the set of changepoint indices.

``` r
changepoints(x)
```

``` R
## [1] 330
```

If the original time series has time labels, we can also retrieve that
information.

``` r
changepoints(x, use_labels = TRUE)
```

``` R
## [1] "1988-01-01"
```

The
[`fitness()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fitness.md)
function returns the both the value and the name of the objective
function that the algorithm used to find the optimal changepoint set.

``` r
fitness(x)
```

``` R
##    MBIC 
## 688.331
```

The [`tidy()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/tidy.html) method
shows the fitted parameters values for each region.

``` r
tidy(x)
```

``` R
## Registered S3 method overwritten by 'tsibble':
##   method               from 
##   as_tibble.grouped_df dplyr

## # A tibble: 2 × 9
##   region    num_obs   min   max  mean    sd begin   end param_mu
##   <chr>       <int> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 [1,330)       329  6.86  10.6  9.17 0.615     1   330     9.17
## 2 [330,367)      37  8.95  11.2 10.3  0.528   330   367    10.3
```

## Algorithmic coverage

``` r
ls_methods()
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 15 × 5
##    method      pkg             segmenter_class helper              wraps        
##    <chr>       <chr>           <chr>           <chr>               <chr>        
##  1 pelt        changepoint     cpt             segment_pelt()      changepoint:…
##  2 binseg      changepoint     cpt             <NA>                changepoint:…
##  3 segneigh    changepoint     cpt             <NA>                changepoint:…
##  4 single-best changepoint     cpt             <NA>                changepoint:…
##  5 wbs         wbs             wbs             <NA>                wbs::wbs()   
##  6 ga          GA              tidyga          segment_ga()        GA::ga()     
##  7 ga-shi      GA              tidyga          segment_ga_shi()    segment_ga() 
##  8 ga-coen     GA              tidyga          segment_ga_coen()   segment_ga() 
##  9 coen        tidychangepoint seg_basket      segment_coen()      <NA>         
## 10 random      GA              tidyga          segment_ga_random() segment_ga() 
## 11 manual      tidychangepoint seg_cpt         segment_manual()    <NA>         
## 12 null        tidychangepoint seg_cpt         segment_manual()    <NA>         
## 13 strucchange strucchange     breakpointsfull <NA>                strucchange:…
## 14 segmented   segmented       segmented       <NA>                segmented::s…
## 15 cptga       changepointGA   tidycptga       segment_cptga()     changepointG…
```

``` r
ls_coverage() |>
  dplyr::group_by(method) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    models = paste(unique(model), collapse = ", "),
    penalties = paste(unique(penalty), collapse = ", ")
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(method) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

| method      | models                                                                                                                                                              | penalties                                                 |
|:------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------|
| binseg      | fit_meanvar                                                                                                                                                         | None, SIC, BIC, MBIC, AIC, HQC, Asymptotic, Manual, CROPS |
| coen        | fit_nhpp                                                                                                                                                            | BMDL                                                      |
| cptga       | NA                                                                                                                                                                  | NA                                                        |
| ga          | fit_arima, fit_lmshift, fit_lmshift_ar1, fit_meanshift_lnorm, fit_meanshift_norm, fit_meanshift_norm_ar1, fit_meanvar, fit_nhpp, fit_trendshift, fit_trendshift_ar1 | SIC, AIC, BIC, HQC, MBIC, MDL                             |
| ga-coen     | fit_nhpp                                                                                                                                                            | BMDL                                                      |
| ga-shi      | fit_meanshift_norm_ar1                                                                                                                                              | BIC                                                       |
| manual      | fit_meanshift_norm                                                                                                                                                  | BIC                                                       |
| null        | fit_meanshift_norm                                                                                                                                                  | BIC                                                       |
| pelt        | fit_meanshift_norm, fit_meanvar                                                                                                                                     | None, SIC, BIC, MBIC, AIC, HQC, Asymptotic, Manual, CROPS |
| random      | fit_arima, fit_lmshift, fit_lmshift_ar1, fit_meanshift_lnorm, fit_meanshift_norm, fit_meanshift_norm_ar1, fit_meanvar, fit_nhpp, fit_trendshift, fit_trendshift_ar1 | SIC, AIC, BIC, HQC, MBIC, MDL                             |
| segmented   | NA                                                                                                                                                                  | NA                                                        |
| segneigh    | fit_meanvar                                                                                                                                                         | None, SIC, BIC, MBIC, AIC, HQC, Asymptotic, Manual, CROPS |
| single-best | fit_meanvar                                                                                                                                                         | None, SIC, BIC, MBIC, AIC, HQC, Asymptotic, Manual, CROPS |
| strucchange | NA                                                                                                                                                                  | NA                                                        |
| wbs         | NA                                                                                                                                                                  | NA                                                        |

## References

Please read [the full
paper](https://beanumber.github.io/changepoint-paper/) for more details.

To cite the package, use the following information:

``` r
citation("tidychangepoint")
```

``` R

##   }
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BMDL()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/BMDL.md)
  : Bayesian Maximum Descriptive Length

- [`CET`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/CET.md)
  : Hadley Centre Central England Temperature

- [`DataCPSim`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/DataCPSim.md)
  [`rlnorm_ts_1`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/DataCPSim.md)
  [`rlnorm_ts_2`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/DataCPSim.md)
  [`rlnorm_ts_3`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/DataCPSim.md)
  : Simulated time series data

- [`HQC()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/HQC.md)
  : Hannan–Quinn information criterion

- [`MBIC()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/MBIC.md)
  : Modified Bayesian Information Criterion

- [`MDL()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/MDL.md)
  : Maximum Descriptive Length

- [`SIC()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/SIC.md)
  : Schwarz information criterion

- [`as.model()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as.model.md)
  [`is_model()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as.model.md)
  : Convert, retrieve, or verify a model object

- [`as.segmenter()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as.segmenter.md)
  [`as.seg_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as.segmenter.md)
  [`is_segmenter()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as.segmenter.md)
  : Convert, retrieve, or verify a segmenter object

- [`as_year()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/as_year.md)
  : Convert a date into a year

- [`binary2tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/binary2tau.md)
  [`tau2binary()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/binary2tau.md)
  : Convert changepoint sets to binary strings

- [`bogota_pm`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/bogota_pm.md)
  : Particulate matter in Bogotá, Colombia

- [`build_gabin_population()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/build_gabin_population.md)
  [`log_gabin_population()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/build_gabin_population.md)
  : Initialize populations in genetic algorithms

- [`changepoints()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/changepoints.md)
  : Extract changepoints

- [`compare_models()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/compare_models.md)
  [`compare_algorithms()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/compare_models.md)
  : Compare various models or algorithms for a given changepoint set

- [`cut_by_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/cut_by_tau.md)
  [`split_by_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/cut_by_tau.md)
  : Use a changepoint set to break a time series into regions

- [`deg_free()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/deg_free.md)
  :

  Retrieve the degrees of freedom from a `logLik` object

- [`diagnose()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/diagnose.md)
  : Diagnose the fit of a segmented time series

- [`exceedances()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/exceedances.md)
  : Compute exceedances of a threshold for a time series

- [`file_name()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/file_name.md)
  : Obtain a descriptive filename for a tidycpt object

- [`fit_arima()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_arima.md)
  : Fit an ARIMA model

- [`fit_lmshift()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_lmshift.md)
  [`fit_lmshift_ar1()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_lmshift.md)
  [`fit_trendshift()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_lmshift.md)
  [`fit_trendshift_ar1()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_lmshift.md)
  : Regression-based model fitting

- [`fit_meanshift()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_meanshift.md)
  [`fit_meanshift_norm()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_meanshift.md)
  [`fit_meanshift_lnorm()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_meanshift.md)
  [`fit_meanshift_norm_ar1()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_meanshift.md)
  : Fast implementation of meanshift model

- [`fit_meanvar()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_meanvar.md)
  : Fit a model for mean and variance

- [`fit_nhpp()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fit_nhpp.md)
  : Fit a non-homogeneous Poisson process model to the exceedances of a
  time series.

- [`fitness()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fitness.md)
  : Retrieve the optimal fitness (or objective function) value used by
  an algorithm

- [`new_fun_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fun_cpt.md)
  [`validate_fun_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fun_cpt.md)
  [`fun_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/fun_cpt.md)
  : Class for model-fitting functions

- [`italy_grads`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/italy_grads.md)
  : Italian University graduates by disciplinary groups from 1926-2013

- [`iweibull()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/iweibull.md)
  [`mweibull()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/iweibull.md)
  [`parameters_weibull()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/iweibull.md)
  : Weibull distribution functions

- [`ls_models()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  [`ls_pkgs()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  [`ls_methods()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  [`ls_penalties()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  [`ls_cpt_penalties()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  [`ls_coverage()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/ls_pkgs.md)
  : Algorithmic coverage through tidychangepoint

- [`mcdf()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mcdf.md)
  : Cumulative distribution of the exceedances of a time series

- [`mde_rain`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mde_rain.md)
  [`mde_rain_monthly`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mde_rain.md)
  : Rainfall in Medellín, Colombia

- [`mlb_diffs`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mlb_diffs.md)
  : Differences between leagues in Major League Baseball

- [`new_mod_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mod_cpt.md)
  [`validate_mod_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mod_cpt.md)
  [`mod_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/mod_cpt.md)
  : Base class for changepoint models

- [`model_args()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/model_args.md)
  : Retrieve the arguments that a model-fitting function used

- [`model_name()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/model_name.md)
  : Retrieve the name of the model that a segmenter or model used

- [`model_variance()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/model_variance.md)
  : Compute model variance

- [`pad_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/pad_tau.md)
  [`unpad_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/pad_tau.md)
  [`is_valid_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/pad_tau.md)
  [`regions_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/pad_tau.md)
  [`validate_tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/pad_tau.md)
  : Pad and unpad changepoint sets with boundary points

- [`plot(`*`<tidyga>`*`)`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/plot.tidyga.md)
  : Plot GA information

- [`plot_best_chromosome()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/plot_best_chromosome.md)
  [`plot_cpt_repeated()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/plot_best_chromosome.md)
  :

  Diagnostic plots for `seg_basket` objects

- [`plot_intensity()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/plot_intensity.md)
  : Plot the intensity of an NHPP fit

- [`regions()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/regions.md)
  : Extract the regions from a tidycpt object

- [`new_seg_basket()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/seg_basket.md)
  [`seg_basket()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/seg_basket.md)
  : Default class for candidate changepoint sets

- [`new_seg_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/seg_cpt.md)
  [`seg_cpt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/seg_cpt.md)
  : Base class for segmenters

- [`seg_params()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/seg_params.md)
  : Retrieve parameters from a segmenter

- [`segment()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment.md)
  : Segment a time series using a variety of algorithms

- [`segment_cptga()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_cptga.md)
  : Segment a time series using a genetic algorithm

- [`segment_ga()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_ga.md)
  [`segment_ga_shi()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_ga.md)
  [`segment_ga_coen()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_ga.md)
  [`segment_ga_random()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_ga.md)
  : Segment a time series using a genetic algorithm

- [`segment_manual()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_manual.md)
  : Manually segment a time series

- [`segment_pelt()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/segment_pelt.md)
  : Segment a time series using the PELT algorithm

- [`tau2time()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/tau2time.md)
  [`time2tau()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/tau2time.md)
  : Convert changepoint sets to time indices

- [`tbl_coef()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/tbl_coef.md)
  : Format the coefficients from a linear model as a tibble

- [`test_set()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/test_set.md)
  : Simulate time series with known changepoint sets

- [`tidycpt-class`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/tidycpt-class.md)
  :

  Container class for `tidycpt` objects

- [`whomademe()`](https://beanumber.github.io/tidychangepoint/reference/whomademe.md)
  : Recover the function that created a model
